title: Why does my breaker keep tripping?
description: The common reasons a circuit breaker keeps tripping in Dubai homes and offices, and when to call an electrician.
body: A breaker that trips again and again is doing its job: it is protecting the circuit. The question is what is causing it.
Too many high-power appliances on one circuit, such as kettles, heaters and irons, can trip the breaker. Spread them across different sockets and circuits.
Unplug everything on that circuit, reset the breaker, then plug items back in one at a time. If it trips when a particular appliance is connected, that appliance is likely the problem.
If the RCD trips, there may be moisture or damaged wiring, often in outdoor lights, bathrooms or water heaters. This needs an electrician.
If you smell burning or see scorch marks, switch off at the board and call us. Do not keep resetting the breaker.
